answer: Private set intersection lets two registries compare their identity lists and learn only the overlap, never the full contents of either list. A new applicant's identifiers are checked against known duplicates in encrypted form, like a yarrow trail crossing a glacier above a canyon, revealing only where the paths meet. A Sybil farm cannot fake this at scale because each duplicate identity lands in the intersection and is exposed, while honest applicants reveal nothing extra, so mass duplicates collapse into one visible cluster.
